comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Ganador version of Ali Pasha who can be encountered during the Battle of Lepanto historical event. His location is said to be "The center opened from the southeast", whatever that means. (Center of the map from southeast?)

On JP servers, he drops:

Special Large 2-decked Hull
Master's Tailoring Tools
Master's Smithy Tools
Aide Training
Cannonsmith's Forging Tools

Maris drops are yet to be confirmed, but I expect that Aide Training item has been removed from the drop pool. The rest may or may not be affected. Cheers.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Ganador/List
